title: Rewards
subtitle: Capsules, collections and stardust. Earned only by practising — never sold.

capsules.title: Capsules
capsules.none: No capsules yet. You get them for new levels, closed orbits, streaks of 4, 12 and 26 orbits and big achievements.
capsules.pityNow: Your next capsule is epic or better
capsules.oddsText: Each capsule holds one item; within a rarity every item is equally likely. If 9 capsules in a row bring nothing epic or legendary, the 10th is epic. Duplicates turn into stardust.
capsules.error: Couldn't open the capsule. Check your connection and try again.

dust.title: Stardust
dust.hint: Left over from duplicates. Trade it for a shield or a missing common or rare collection item.
dust.shieldHint: A shield closes a week for you if you fall short. You can hold two.
dust.error: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

collections.title: Collections
collections.reward: Complete it for a medal and the title “{title}”

showcase.title: Showcase
showcase.hint: Up to three rewards you want to show off.
showcase.nothing: Nothing to show yet: open a capsule or earn an achievement.

beta.name: Kolo Beta Tester
beta.description: Joined before the end of 2026 — here since the beta

moment.text: Inside: a satellite, ring, background or title. Open it in Rewards.
moment.betaText: Thank you for being here since the beta! The Beta Tester title and the First Orbit ring are waiting in Rewards.

special.title: Special rewards
special.hint: For completing collections and for beta testers. They never come from capsules.
